A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the DSPs and the FPGA are the most energy-efficient solutions for lightweight ConvNet configurations on embedded systems.

the CaffePresso framework can deliver a 3--5x performance improvement over Caffe on the same hardware for small datasets, while also providing the option of porting the same ConvNet configuration to other platforms with a single command.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, with careful design of the ConvNet architecture, and a well-tuned mapping of the ConvNet to the platform, one can achieve high energy-efficiency for lightweight ConvNets on embedded platforms.
